svg.title: How a run's numbers become Table 1 and Table 2
svg.desc: Seven steps turn a completed run into the cells of main Tables 1 and 2 and the supplementary ledgers. The candidate family is executed on the selection units; nested selection applies the registered reading of Eq. 19 with the eligibility threshold, the near-best band and the simplicity order; the confirmation map applies predeclared contrasts with practical margins under Holm; admission applies the clipped empirical-Bernstein bound of Eq. 27, a coverage statement only on independent graphs; the policy lock fixes the deployed rule before any test label is read; the test-stage effect is a paired whole-unit bootstrap; the cost ledger reports controller, comparator, expected and assurance costs. Each step names the sealed file it is read from and the table cell it fills. The serving-time fallback probability is not measured in this release, so the expected cost equals the controller cost.
